$description: Semantic colour roles. A role is either THEMED (it carries $refDark and $refLight, one foundation token per palette) or a LITERAL (one $ref, identical in both palettes). tokens/themes/light.json and tokens/themes/dark.json resolve every role in this file to exactly one foundation token.
idConvention: Token ids are dotted, lower-case, tier-prefix-free. Foundation ids are <category>.<name> (color.mainbg-dark, type.h1, spacing.1, radius.md, breakpoint.tablet, elevation.z-header, icon-size.header-logo, motion.transition.fast). Semantic ids are <role>.<variant> (text.primary, surface.page, border.hairline, accent.primary). Component ids start with component.<name>.<slot>, layout ids with layout.<name>. A "$ref" is always another token id.
paletteInversionWarning: The LIGHT theme is the DEFAULT rendered theme, because the app ships <body class="body dark"> and .body.dark carries the light values. See tokens/themes/light.json.
vendorRoleNote: The four vendor.cookie-* roles describe the Finsweet Cookie Consent component that was vendored into this site. They are deliberately namespaced so a generator cannot mistake #146ef5 for a Fourmula brand colour.

text.primary.rationale: Headings and full-strength copy. Applied through .u-fonts-100, the most used text utility in the markup.

text.muted.rationale: Second line of a two-tone heading and secondary labels. 20 occurrences of .u-fonts-50 in src/**/*.jsx, plus 4 of the separate .u-fonts-50-stb class used on the step slides.

text.faint.rationale: Referenced three times in site-authored CSS: background-color of .ai__dot (2874), color of .ai__grid-arrow (3376) and color of .cookies__modal__close (4314). There is NO .u-fonts-30 utility class, so this role is reachable only through those three rules, never from the markup.

text.ghost.rationale: Every 1px hairline border declared as var(--fonts-20): 7 site-authored uses (3440, 3501, 3606, 3789, 4395, 4603, 5868). There is no .u-fonts-20 utility class.

surface.page.rationale: The page canvas. background-color: var(--mainbg) on .body.

surface.page-fade.rationale: The fully transparent companion of surface.page, for gradient scrims over the canvas.

surface.dots.rationale: The footer dots-field surface and the .btn-outline.is-cookies resting fill.

accent.menu.rationale: Menu accent. The ONLY role whose value is identical in both palettes (#fff3 in each), so it is modelled as a literal rather than a themed pair.

accent.hover.rationale: The single interactive accent. HOVER ONLY - never a resting fill.

accent.flash-start.rationale: First colour of the runtime flash-word reveal.

accent.flash-mid.rationale: Second colour of the runtime flash-word reveal; also the shared end stop of all four step gradients.

accent.flash-end.rationale: End colour of the m24 variant of the reveal ONLY; m23 and m25 end on text.primary instead.

surface.invert-pill.rationale: Resting fill of .ai__btn, a white pill that does not follow the palette.

border.table-cell.rationale: Bottom border of a legal-page table cell.

surface.table-head.rationale: Fill of a legal-page table header cell.

border.table-head.rationale: Bottom border of a legal-page table header cell.

vendor.cookie-accent.rationale: VENDORED Finsweet Cookie Consent accent. Not a Fourmula brand colour. Do not reuse it for brand UI.
